tenderSchedule.description: Supply of Manpower of different categories to DSERT, Mass education, DSERT Guest House and SERIC Library

tenderAddress.blockNumber: DSERT, no4, 100 feet ring road, BSK 3rd stage, Hosakerehalli, Bangalore

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All terms and condition as per tender document

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder must have a Company Registered under the provisions of the Companies Act or A firm Registered in Karnataka with the Competent Authority.
The Company / firm should have been in the business for providing Man power Resource at least for the last 3 years
Company/firm should have a certificate of legal status, Place of Registration and Principal place of business of the Firm. Renewal of registration should be produced

The Company Should have registered their firm as per the private Security Agencies (Regulation) Act-2005 & the Private Security Agencies (Karnataka) Rule-2008 with competent authority and registration shall be valid till the completion of the tender service

Company/firm should have a GST Registration and have filed the returns as per the prevailing rules. Copy of latest GSTR-3B Form and Annual returns filed for the year 2026 shall be uploaded in the portal

The Company/firm should have previous experiences in the field of providing man power services, and should have provided the man power services to Govt / private organizations during the past three years ie., 2022-23, 2023-24 & 2024-25
Company/firm should have a Average Annual Turnover of Rs.1.00 crore during the past three audited years i.e., 2022-23, 2023-24 & 2024-25
Company/firm should have an acknowledgement of Income Tax returns filed in the last three years i.e. 2022-23, 2023-24 & 2024-25
Copy of pan card should be provided Company/firm should have EPF Registration and EPF returns filed in the last three financial years i.e., 2022-23, 2023-24 & 2024-25
Company/firm should have a ESI Registration and ESI returns filed in the last three financial years i.e. 2022-23, 2023-24 & 2024-25
